design.before: Line-level visual/number/qualifier seeds, almost all no-cue lines KEEP_UNKNOWN; only explicit noncontent lines deferred. Not a genuine complete-unit positive retrieval pass.
design.after: Whole literal reliable paragraph/continued-source units selected by broad visual/modality/descriptive/figure-table hints, plus explicit referential context. Complete cue-negative units outside closure are unprioritized/deferred. Ambiguous, incomplete, overlapping, unfamiliar and continuation units remain visible.
design.deferred_meaning: Not initially prioritized; explicit authorized reread remains available. Neither source deletion nor medical-irrelevance classification.
design.immutable: B0 source states and shared bibliography mask unchanged; PDF/raw/IR/offsets/catalog assets unchanged. Only selector version advances; source-unit4, visual2 and bibliography1 remain.
design.fallback: Missing or unverified structure defaults to kept; existing narrowly explicit noncontent line fallback remains, with mixed visual source now protected before boilerplate prefix.
design.missing_novel_phrases: Rules cannot recognize every previously unseen visual wording. No closed feature whitelist or zero-omission guarantee is claimed.
design.title_scope: No entire Methods/Discussion section exclusion and no blanket numeric exclusion.
design.context_measurement: Actual first tool outputs include complete source_units and structural context. Batch planning and sentence completion are the production functions. Explicit reread upper bound is separate from initial dispatch.

metrics_scope.counts: Original raw textline blocks, not paragraph/citation counts.
metrics_scope.characters: Unicode code points, not model tokens or billed fees.
metrics_scope.payload: One production closed read result per planned batch, including source_units and document_structure; no model prompt/request/retry transcript was generated. Repeated source exposure across batches is counted separately.
metrics_scope.future_experiment: New real B0/F comparison needs new explicit paid authorization and user review of F omissions. L01 has equal current model inputs, not independent treatment evidence or general proof that F is inapplicable.

initial.reason: New test assumed © starts a complete unit; existing literal unit4 conservatively marks that start unverified. Corrected test to a complete Copyright sentence; no boundary policy was weakened.

evidence_inventory_note: To avoid repeated inventories, B0 states and exclusion mask use deterministic SHA256 plus counts; before-F2 deferred entries/text and after-F3 deferred units/deltas are listed explicitly. Original source IDs/text remain reproducible from the bound unchanged IR.
